Project Name: KisanSight

Target Users: Farmers, agriculture students, researchers

Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript

Backend: Python (Flask or Django)

AI/ML: Python-based ML models (lightweight, explainable)

Languages Supported: English, Hindi, Bengali

🎯 PROJECT GOAL

Build an agriculture-focused web application that shows how climate, soil, and weather impact crop production in India, provides crop yield prediction, crop recommendations, farm reports, and crop disease detection using images.
The website should be simple, fast, farmer-friendly, and multilingual.

🌾 CORE FEATURES
1️⃣ Location-Based Crop Analysis

Users select:

State (India)

District (auto-suggested based on state)

The system analyzes:

Weather

Rainfall

Temperature

Soil condition

Output:

Suitable crops for the selected area

Area suitability score (Low / Medium / High)

2️⃣ Crop Predictor (Enhanced)

Users can enter:

State

District

Soil Type

Soil pH

Nitrogen (N)

Phosphorus (P)

Potassium (K)

Average rainfall (mm)

Average temperature (°C)

Predictions Provided:

Best crops for the area

Estimated yield (tons per hectare)

Crop suitability score

Risk factors (low rain, poor soil, etc.)

3️⃣ Farm Report (New Option)

Generate a detailed Farm Report including:

Recommended crops for the selected soil & climate

Total rainfall received (historical data)

Soil health summary

Soil improvement tips (pH correction, fertilizer use)

Water management suggestions

Estimated crop yield per hectare

4️⃣ Crop Disease Detection

User uploads an image of a crop leaf

AI detects:

Crop disease name

Severity level

AI suggests:

Treatment methods

Preventive steps

Fertilizer or pesticide advice

⏳ GRANULAR LOADING STATES (VERY IMPORTANT)
Crop Predictor – Loading Messages:

Show step-by-step loading indicators:

“Fetching weather data…”

“Analyzing soil conditions…”

“Processing rainfall history…”

“Estimating crop yield…”

“Generating farm report…”

Disease Detector – Loading Messages:

“Uploading image…”

“Analyzing crop image…”

“Detecting disease…”

“Preparing solution & advice…”

🗺️ DISTRICT SUGGESTION SYSTEM

When a user selects a State:

Automatically populate District suggestions

Implement:

Searchable dropdown / autocomplete input

District list must update dynamically based on the selected state

This must work smoothly without page reloads

🌐 LANGUAGE SUPPORT (VERY IMPORTANT)

Languages:

English

Hindi

Bengali

Requirements:

Language switch updates all UI text instantly

No page reload required

Includes:

Buttons

Headings

Labels

Placeholders

Error messages

Loading messages

🤖 AI PROMPT LOGIC (SIMPLIFIED FOR AI)

AI should receive clean, structured inputs only, such as:

Location (state, district)

Soil data (type, pH, NPK)

Climate data (rainfall, temperature)

AI should return:

Crop recommendations

Yield estimate per hectare

Soil improvement advice

Risk analysis (simple language)

🎨 UI & UX GUIDELINES

Very simple and clean design

Farmer-friendly wording

Large buttons and readable fonts

Icons and visuals where helpful

Mobile-friendly layout © 2025 KisanSight. All rights reserved.
✅ FINAL OUTPUT EXPECTATION
Fully functional agriculture web app

Accurate crop prediction & disease detection

Smooth loading feedback

Smart district suggestions

Perfect multilingual support

Easy for farmers to understand and use

**Envisioning KisanSight's Scope**

I'm now focusing on defining the comprehensive scope for the "KisanSight" React application. Initial thoughts center on location-based crop analysis and yield prediction, driven by NP. The goal is to provide Indian farmers with precise, actionable insights.


**Expanding KisanSight's Features**

I am now integrating several key features into KisanSight. I'm focusing on multilingual support and smart district suggestions. I'm also ensuring granular loading states and a responsive UI. The technical foundation is solid: React, Tailwind, and the Gemini API, now with a planned file structure to support these additions, and I'm developing detailed components for core functionality.


**Defining KisanSight's Architecture**

I'm solidifying the application's architecture now. Key components like `FarmReport.tsx`, `LocationAnalysis.tsx`, `Header.tsx`, and `Footer.tsx` are taking shape. I'm focusing on UI/UX with large, farmer-friendly buttons, and a green/earth color palette, alongside responsive design. I'm also planning the logic for calling Gemini API for both prediction and disease detection, and multilingual support is a priority. I'm focusing on defining system instructions for the AI to emulate an agricultural expert and refining prompts for clear responses.
